name: 16-high-pay-new-regime
why: Pay of 2 lakh a month under the new regime, with six months already paid this tax year. By hand: income 6 x 198,200 so far + 198,200 this month + 5 x 198,200 ahead = 2,378,400; less 75,000 standard deduction = 2,303,400; slabs 20,000 + 40,000 + 60,000 + 80,000 + 25% of 303,400 (75,850) = 275,850; with 4% cess 286,884. Half is already deducted (143,442), so the remaining 143,442 over 6 months is 23,907 a month.
